mythology.lead: The stories of Perseus place hero, slayer of medousa at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Perseus appears in greek tradition as hero, slayer of medousa. The name's meaning, "Destroyer, possibly Persian", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Perseus in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Perseus remains a touchstone for understanding greek religion, art, and identity.
scholarlySources: Hesiod, Theogony and Works and Days.
